City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
July 5, 2011
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of plaque to Candice Bergan for receiving the Outstanding Older American Award.
Presentation of Certificates of Appreciation to Soo Bahk Do Championship winners and instructor.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: June 20, 2011
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
e.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report submitting investment and treasury report for the month of May. RECEIVE AND FILE.
g.
Report dealing with activities of the public works department for the month of June. RECEIVE AND FILE.
h.
Report recommending second reading and adoption of Ordinance 746, amending Ordinance 726 to add the non-utility pipeline fee schedule to the existing pipeline franchise with ConocoPhillips Company. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report requesting authorization to advertise and hire for the part time position of Video Technician. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
j.
Report submitting Change Order Nos. 5 and 6 with Psomas for a combined total of $12,998. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
k.
Report recommending award of contract to Pavement Coatings Company for the 2011 citywide slurry seal project in the amount of $141,888 plus a 15% contingency for a total project budget of $163,171. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
PUBLIC HEARING
6.LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT Public Hearing on proposed assessment for the annual maintenance, operation and servicing of the parkway landscaping along the north side of Palos Verdes Drive North and resolution approving the engineer’s report and confirming the assessment for 2011/12. Presented by Public Works Director Damasse
7.
ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 2011-04 (MIXED USE OVERLAY) Public Hearing on the proposed Zone Text Amendment 2011-04, a city-initiated amendment to the Lomita Municipal Code amending the standards of development within the Mixed Use Overlay Zone, specifically Sections 11-1.58.06 (C), (D), and (F); to permit studio units with a minimum size of 500 square feet, to maintain a height limit of 35 feet without reference to number of stories, and to modify the parking ratio for the residential component only.
Presented by Asst. City Manager Sugano.
ADJOURNMENT
Adjourn in memory of Daniel Green, brother of Nick Green, Daily Breeze reporter, to 6 pm on July 18, 2011 for an economic development workshop
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
